title: Stock

adjustments.title: Stock adjustments
adjustments.subtitle: Correct stock when the real quantity differs from the system. Every change is kept in the ledger with its reason.
adjustments.emptyHint: Adjustments and posted stock counts show here.

form.title: New stock adjustment
form.help: Damage and loss remove stock, found adds it; a correction can go either way.
form.search: Find a product by name, SKU or barcode
form.unitsHelpOut: Serials in stock in this branch.
form.unitsHelpIn: Written-off serials that were found again.
form.unitsFailed: The serials could not be loaded.

errors.validation: Check the lines: quantities must be whole numbers above zero.
errors.sign: This reason can't move stock in that direction.
errors.outOfStock: Not enough stock in this branch for one of the lines.
errors.unit: One of the serials is not available for this change.
errors.dayClosed: The day is closed for this branch.

errors.branch: You can't change stock in this branch.
errors.notFound: A product or serial was not found.
errors.failed: The adjustment could not be posted. Try again.

counts.title: Stock counts
counts.subtitle: Count what is on the shelves; posting makes the stock equal to what you counted.
counts.emptyHint: Start a count for a branch or one category.

form.title: New stock count
form.help: The sheet lists every product (and every serial) in the branch, or in the chosen category with its subcategories.

sheet.title: Stock count {number}
sheet.scan: Scan or type a barcode, SKU or serial
sheet.search: Search by name, SKU, barcode or serial
sheet.liveHint: Expected is the stock right now, so the difference is what posting will change.
sheet.postHelp: {in} units will be added and {out} removed, in one adjustment with the reason "Stock count".
sheet.uncountedAsZero: Treat lines that are not counted as zero (missing)
sheet.cancelHelp: Nothing in stock changes. You can start a new count afterwards.
sheet.loadFailed: The count could not be loaded.

errors.open: A count of these products is already open in this branch. Finish or cancel it first.
errors.outOfScope: This product is not in the count's categories.
errors.unitElsewhere: This serial is in stock in another branch.
errors.unitRequired: Scan the serial of this product, not its barcode.
errors.final: This count is already posted or cancelled.
errors.validation: Counted quantities must be whole numbers, 0 or more.
errors.outOfStock: The stock changed and a removal is not possible (reserved stock). Count again.
errors.dayClosed: The day is closed for this branch.
errors.permission: You don't have permission to count stock.
errors.failed: That did not work. Try again.
errors.unitUnavailable: This serial was sold or left the shop; it can't be counted here.

transfers.title: Branch transfers
transfers.subtitle: Move stock between branches. Sent stock shows as in transit until the receiving branch confirms it.
transfers.emptyHint: Create a transfer to move stock to another branch.

form.title: New transfer
form.help: Nothing moves until you send it. Serialized products are sent by serial.
form.search: Find a product by name, SKU or barcode
form.unitsHelp: Serials in stock in the source branch.
form.noUnits: No serials in stock in this branch.
form.unitsFailed: The serials could not be loaded.

detail.title: Transfer {number}
detail.sendHelp: {count} units leave {from} now and show as in transit at {to}.
detail.cancelHelp: Nothing has moved yet; the draft is closed.
detail.loadFailed: The transfer could not be loaded.

receive.title: Receive transfer {number}
receive.help: Enter what actually arrived. Anything missing or broken is written off here with its reason.

errors.notSent: This transfer hasn't been sent yet.

units.subtitle: Every phone, laptop or TV with its own serial or IMEI: where it is and everything that happened to it.
units.emptyHint: Register the serials you have, or change the search.

register.help: For serialized products you already have. Each serial can exist only once in the shop.
register.serialsHelp: Scan or type; letters are stored in capitals.

history.title: Movement history
history.subtitle: Every stock movement with the balance after it and the document that caused it. Filter by product, branch, serial, type or date.
history.productSearch: Search a product by name, SKU or barcode
history.emptyHint: Change the filters, or post stock first (adjustments, transfers, serials).

minLevels.cleared: The branch uses the default level again.
